However, a multi-week technical audit conducted in February 2026 reveals that this \"all-in-one\" agent may function as an opaque pipeline for sensitive, unpublished research data."]}],"\n",["$","p","p-2",{"children":["While the tool provides a functional product, the primary concern is that ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"researchers are sending unpublished work through a chain of unidentifiable entities with zero data protection commitments."}]]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-0",{}],"\n",["$","h2","h2-1",{"children":"Technical Red Flags: A Timeline of Evasion"}],"\n",["$","h3","h3-0",{"children":"1. The Obfuscation Pivot and Distribution Tactics"}],"\n",["$","p","p-3",{"children":["Initially, Einsia was distributed as a manual ZIP download from ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Alibaba Cloud"}],", requiring users to enable \"Developer Mode\" and bypass the Chrome Web Store (CWS) review process entirely."]}],"\n",["$","ul","ul-0",{"children":["\n",["$","li","li-0",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Intentional Secrecy:"}]," Versions v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 used ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"javascript-obfuscator"}]," to hide over ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"164,000 identifiers"}]," and ",["$","strong","strong-2",{"children":"84,000 hex-encoded string literals"}],"."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-1",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Banned Techniques:"}]," This specific obfuscation method has been ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"banned from the CWS since 2019"}]," because it is a primary indicator of malicious intent, found in over 70% of blocked malicious extensions."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-2",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"The \"Reaction\" Update:"}]," On February 13, 2026—just two days after security concerns were raised in the Einsia Discord—",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"v0.1.2"}]," was released, removing the obfuscation and listing the tool on the CWS. While the code is now readable, the underlying data risks persist."]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","h3","h3-1",{"children":"2. A Pipeline with Three Shadows: Where Does Your Data Go?"}],"\n",["$","p","p-4",{"children":["Traffic interception using ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"mitmproxy"}]," reveals that document content does not simply stay between the user and Einsia. When the chat feature is utilized, data follows a complex, undisclosed chain:"]}],"\n",["$","table","table-0",{"children":[["$","thead","thead-0",{"children":["$","tr","tr-0",{"children":[["$","th","th-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Stage"}],["$","th","th-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Entity"}],["$","th","th-2",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Role"}]]}]}],["$","tbody","tbody-0",{"children":[["$","tr","tr-0",{"children":[["$","td","td-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"1"}]}],["$","td","td-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Einsia.ai"}]}],["$","td","td-2",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"API gateway hosted on Alibaba Cloud in Singapore"}]]}],["$","tr","tr-1",{"children":[["$","td","td-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"2"}]}],["$","td","td-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"OpenRouter"}]}],["$","td","td-2",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Intermediate LLM aggregator that facilitates model access"}]]}],["$","tr","tr-2",{"children":[["$","td","td-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"3"}]}],["$","td","td-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Google Gemini 3 Flash"}]}],["$","td","td-2",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Final destination for the document content"}]]}]]}]]}],"\n",["$","p","p-5",{"children":["Critically, ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"neither OpenRouter nor Google is disclosed in the privacy policy"}]," as a data processor. Researchers are unknowingly subjecting their proprietary work to three different sets of terms and conditions."]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-1",{}],"\n",["$","h2","h2-2",{"children":"The Attribution: Finding the Unknown \"Author\""}],"\n",["$","p","p-6",{"children":["To understand the origins of this tool, the audit moved beyond client-side code and into infrastructure analysis. By leveraging ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Validin"}],", an advanced DNS intelligence platform, we were able to pivot through the digital footprints of the ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"einsia.ai"}]," domain."]}],"\n",["$","h3","h3-2",{"children":"Infrastructure Pivoting with Validin"}],"\n",["$","p","p-7",{"children":"Using Validin's passive DNS and host response history, we identified critical links that the developers likely intended to keep separate:"}],"\n",["$","ul","ul-1",{"children":["\n",["$","li","li-0",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Host Connections:"}]," Validin identified historical IP overlaps and host response fingerprints that linked ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"einsia.ai"}]," directly to ",["$","code","code-1",{"children":"nbdevenv.xiaoaojianghu.fun"}],"."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-1",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"The Identity:"}]," A Chinese AI researcher."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-2",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Institutional Ties:"}]," The investigation found that the backend utilizes ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"ByteDance's Feishu (Lark)"}]," enterprise suite and ",["$","strong","strong-2",{"children":"Alibaba Cloud"}]," infrastructure. Server timestamps consistently return ",["$","strong","strong-3",{"children":"China Standard Time (+08:00)"}],", and API calls contain hardcoded ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"zh-CN"}]," language headers."]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","p","p-8",{"children":["This confirms the tool is operated by a research group in a jurisdiction with some vested interest in monitoring Western AI research developments—",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"all while masquerading as a standard academic productivity tool."}]]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-2",{}],"\n",["$","h2","h2-3",{"children":"Agentic Overreach and WebSocket Interception"}],"\n",["$","p","p-9",{"children":["The extension utilizes an ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"\"agentic\""}]," design, meaning the AI autonomously decides when to read or modify your files without per-action confirmation."]}],"\n",["$","ul","ul-2",{"children":["\n",["$","li","li-0",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Silent Full-File Reads:"}]," A simple request like \"review my intro\" triggers a ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"Read"}]," tool call, causing the extension to ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"fetch the entire contents of your LaTeX project"}]," and upload it to the server as a tool response."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-1",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"MAIN World Injection:"}]," The extension injects ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"inject.js"}]," into the ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"\"Main World\""}]," of the browser at ",["$","code","code-1",{"children":"document_start"}],". This allows it to ",["$","strong","strong-2",{"children":"patch the WebSocket constructor"}]," and monitor every real-time edit and cursor movement before Overleaf's own security layers even load."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-2",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Telemetry without Consent:"}]," The extension reports usage duration to ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"einsia.ai"}]," even if the user is not logged in or authenticated."]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-3",{}],"\n",["$","h2","h2-4",{"children":"Manufactured Legitimacy: The Influencer Problem"}],"\n",["$","p","p-10",{"children":"Einsia's growth has been fueled by a social media presence that appears highly inorganic."}],"\n",["$","ul","ul-3",{"children":["\n",["$","li","li-0",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Bot Patterns:"}]," Multiple accounts like ",["$","code","code-0",{"children":"@AvaGrace_AI"}]," and ",["$","code","code-1",{"children":"@code_bykuti"}]," use formulaic, near-identical praise and similar writing styles to promote the tool."]}],"\n",["$","li","li-1",{"children":[["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"The \"Useful Idiot\" Risk:"}]," High-profile AI influencers, such as ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"Rohan Paul"}],", have advertised the software to hundreds of thousands of followers. These promotions often occur without the influencer performing any due diligence on the extension's data handling or privacy practices."]}],"\n"]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-4",{}],"\n",["$","h2","h2-5",{"children":"Detailed Risk Assessment for Researchers"}],"\n",["$","table","table-1",{"children":[["$","thead","thead-0",{"children":["$","tr","tr-0",{"children":[["$","th","th-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Threat Category"}],["$","th","th-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Finding"}]]}]}],["$","tbody","tbody-0",{"children":[["$","tr","tr-0",{"children":[["$","td","td-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Data Retention"}]}],["$","td","td-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"Chat histories (including full documents) are stored server-side with no stated deletion policy."}]]}],["$","tr","tr-1",{"children":[["$","td","td-0",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Identity & Accountability"}]}],["$","td","td-1",{"style":{"textAlign":"left"},"children":"No registered business entity exists. Sending proprietary research through an opaque pipeline operated by an unidentifiable entity is a significant security gamble that most institutional data policies would not permit."]}],"\n",["$","hr","hr-6",{}],"\n",["$","p","p-12",{"children":["$","em","em-0",{"children":["Audit conducted by ",["$","strong","strong-0",{"children":"Teja Akella"}]," (Hatndagger), ",["$","strong","strong-1",{"children":"Saketh Reddy"}]," (Hatndagger), ",["$","strong","strong-2",{"children":"Allistair Hakim"}]," (Hatndagger), and ",["$","strong","strong-3",{"children":"Yixiong"}]," (GT AI Safety Initiative).
